"Always wanted to have more art of Shane in the Pokemon world and with Pokémon as well. And a perfect opportunity arose when a new friend wanted to do something with their pokémon.
Here we have a teenage Shane fighting Shiina as a pokémon trainer =3

Long-time watchers might remember Shiina as she was one of the characters I did a lot with in the past, but their owner sold Shiina. Fortunately, Shiina's new owner (anonymous) is also a fan and more than willing to get art with me as well.

After the battle Shane emerged victorious with his Houndour. Umbreon may have had high defense, but had no real way to damage the other dark type either.
Shiina was a bit dejected, especially when she mentioned she didn't have the money. She was counting on winning. So Shane figured out a different prize. He asked Shiina to take off her panties. But the pairing would not quite be what Shiina thought it was going to be. Before she knew it, she was pounced on by Shane's Houndour, while Shane had his way with her Umbreon. Both boys unloading big into their respective partners. Leaving the girls filled to the brim. Carrying both liters and litters..." - Commissioner
